Subject: Exec strategy workshop — high-level ask on agenda & pre-reads

Hi Maya,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the 3-day executive strategy workshop for Novus (May 17-19). Leadership asked me to confirm a couple of planning items so we can kick off vendor travel and internal comms:

- Can you share a proposed agenda skeleton (time blocks + owners) so we can confirm exec availability?
- Who will own each presenter slot (Redwood leads vs Novus SMEs)? We need names for travel approvals.
- Final pre-read package: what assets do you need from us and when is the absolute deadline?

We have two senior execs arriving early (17th morning) and want a private dinner the evening of the 17th. Travel windows: most external presenters fly in late on the 16th.

Appreciate a short outline this week — we’ll treat it as the canonical input for our logistics team.

Best,
Samantha

Senior Program Director | Holloway Consulting
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Thanks Sam — good to have those constraints up front. Team: I put together a first-pass agenda skeleton and a proposed owner map (attached: exec_agenda_draft.xlsx). High level notes below. Please review and flag conflicts by EOD Mon 4/4.

Draft agenda (top-level)
- Day 0 (May 16) — Arrival & internal facilitator run-through (optional)
- Day 1 (May 17) — Opening, business context (Novus execs), product/ops deep dive (Redwood), breakout + synthesis, evening private dinner
- Day 2 (May 18) — Use-case workshops (mixed teams), metrics and cost models (Redwood lead), decision cadence exercise (Novus lead)
- Day 3 (May 19) — Executive synthesis, next-steps & commitments, close

Proposed presenter owners (draft)
- Opening & goals: Troy Benson (Novus) + Naomi Feldman (Redwood) — 45m
- Product/ops deep dive: Maya Srinivasan (Redwood) — 60m
- Use-case breakout facilitation: Logan Wright (Redwood) + Novus SMEs — 90m
- Metrics & cost model: Mateo Alvarez (Redwood) — 60m
- Executive synthesis: Senior Novus exec + Maya — 45m

Pre-read package (initial ask)
- Novus to provide: 1p company strategy memo, current roadmap snapshot, two exemplar customer scenarios (due 4/20)
- Redwood to provide: playbook draft, cost-model primer, facilitator guide (deliver to Novus legal/ops by 4/22)

Action items for our inbox by 4/4:
- Mateo: confirm metrics slot + bring draft cost slides
- Naomi: own arrival/run-of-show logistics with Novus ops (dinner seating, dietary)
- Logan: draft breakout prompts and expected outputs

Attachments: exec_agenda_draft.xlsx (xlsx) — this is a working sheet with time blocks and proposed slide owners.

Quick ask to Sam/Troy: is a 45-60 minute metrics deep-dive reasonable for your execs? We can compress but want to ensure the decision-oriented artifacts are surfaced.

Thanks — Maya
Maya Srinivasan
Program Lead, Customer Workshops | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Exec strategy workshop — agenda skeleton, presenter owners, and pre-read collation

Maya — thanks for the tidy draft. A couple of quick suggestions based on the outcomes Novus told us they care about:

- Move the metrics & cost-model earlier on Day 2 (first session) — executives are more receptive before breakout fatigue. Suggest 45m instead of 60m, and follow with a 30m worked example where we show a 6-12 month run rate (keeps it concrete).
- For breakout prompts, call out one deliverable: a single prioritized action tied to owner + measure. That will make the synthesis concise.
- Presenter prep: I’ll assemble a one-page prep for each Redwood presenter (what to bring, 2 key slides max, xx-minute talking points). Draft attached: presenter_prep_guidelines.docx.

I’ll own the metrics slide deck and the worked example. Logan — can you confirm whether you want a 60 or 90 minute facilitation block for the breakouts? Naomi — once you confirm room layout constraints I’ll map the breakout format.

Deadline note: if Novus needs final pre-reads by 5/3 to distribute to execs, we should lock slide owners by 4/22 and have first drafts in my hands by 4/26.

-Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Principal, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference

Attachment: presenter_prep_guidelines.docx (docx, 22KB)
